notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): parse.rs is Benilla's opcode->parser dispatch covering 193 server opcodes. MSUI's counterpart is the Program.Net.cs switch (plus NetworkClient.cs pre-world handling); roughly 123 of the 193 have real MSUI handlers, 70 have no reference outside the opcode table. The pre-pass missing list contained several false negatives (SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN, SMSG_PARTY_COMMAND_RESULT, SMSG_GROUP_SET_LEADER/DESTROYED/UNINVITE, SMSG_INIT_WORLD_STATES, SMSG_UPDATE_WORLD_STATE, MSG_MINIMAP_PING, MSG_RAID_TARGET_UPDATE, MSG_RAID_READY_CHECK, SMSG_CHANNEL_NOTIFY are all handled).

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: SMSG_INVENTORY_CHANGE_FAILURE being unhandled is notable: every refused equip/store (bag full, wrong slot, level too low) is silent in MSUI, while Benilla surfaces the error code.
